verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents user-controlled deletion: delete by filter and conditional deletes that remove a document only when a condition is met (docs-21, docs-22). Together these give programmatic control over removing data. Nothing in the evidence covers retention, such as TTLs, automatic expiry or configurable retention windows, so only the deletion half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: configurable retention policies/TTL or auto-expiry, documented namespace-level deletion, guarantees on deletion propagation to object storage/backups, independent corroboration.
